profile: release-fast (same binary both arms; relative A/B, not a BASE_TRUE_TPS claim)

toggle.what_it_changes: kernel symbol only. Host bind, recon-fuse occupancy tiles, CB fusion, act-quant, DSV4F FP4 occupancy stay on their own levers.

confound_avoided.do_not_compare_to_morning: This A/B never subtracts this morning's 867.0 ms Q80 gpu_matvec. Reconstruction fuse stayed ON for both arms. A before/after that straddled the fuse would attribute 867->36.6 to the family, which is wrong.
confound_avoided.one_build_one_session: Both arms are the same release-fast binaries hashed below. Alternating family/legacy in one GPU lock, then three more warm pairs after a short gap.
confound_avoided.page_cache: Pair 1 of each lock session (Q80/DSV p1 and p4) is first-touch / page-cache. Family always ran first, so those pairs bias against family. Analysis medians drop p1 and p4. Raw pairs remain in the table (full spread).

q80_mixed.protocol: alternating family/legacy, 12-token greedy, --reps 1 per process, gpu_lane_lock
q80_mixed.shipping_dispatch_note: HAWKING_Q80_RECON_FUSE default ON. dispatch_binary/residual/factor launch occupancy tiles (q80_binary_group_matvec_tg256 / csr_tg256 / hgravs simd3 / uniform8). The family/legacy toggle only fills the unused serial_name. Q80 gpu_matvec is therefore the same occupancy kernels both arms. That is the shipping token path. It is not a serial-wrapper microbench.

dsv4f_native.protocol: alternating family/legacy, one BOS token per process, gpu_lane_lock
dsv4f_native.shipping_dispatch_note: Native graph dispatches the toggled names. Family: gk_pack_worklist / gk_worklist_fp4(_simd) / gk_swiglu_bf16_worklist / gk_combine_bf16. Legacy: dsv4f_pack_worklist / dsv4f_worklist_fp4_matvec(_simd) / dsv4f_worklist_swiglu / dsv4f_worklist_combine. Same helpers, different entry points. HAWKING_DSV4F_FP4_OCCUPANCY stays default-on both arms.

qwen38.protocol: alternating family/legacy, warmup 4 + 16-token generate + isolated 12-component suite, --reps 1, gpu_lane_lock
qwen38.shipping_dispatch_note: Only dense SwiGLU is in the family. Family dispatches gk_swiglu_f32; legacy dispatches qwen80_silu_mul_f32. Q4 matvec / DeltaNet / GQA are STRUCTURAL leftovers and stay on their original kernels.

dense_swiglu.override_reason: Heuristic barely tripped (|median delta| 114.6 us vs band 112 us) on a DERIVED exclusive partition (isolated silu + mlp residual + Q4 MLP FMA remainder). The only family kernel in this row is silu; isolated_silu_64_gpu does_not_move (family 155.3 us vs legacy 180.9 us, signs change). Pair 3 dense_swiglu is 834.8 vs 837.0 us. Not a systematic generality tax.

verdict.headline: No systematic generality tax. Every requested facet is either identical (command_buffers) or inside the warm-pair spread both ways. Q80 shipping GPU work is occupancy tiles either arm; DSV4F and Qwen3.8 SwiGLU actually swap entry points and still do not move.
